It is <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>fortunate for us<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> <tei-milestone facs="#f003_z002" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z001" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">however</tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">, </tei-add>that Nature is so<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> imperfect, as otherwise we <tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f003_z005" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">should</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f003_z005" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">would</tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> have had no <tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f003_z003" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">a</tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z003" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f003_z003" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z003" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">a</tei-del>rt <tei-milestone facs="#f003_z004" unit="enclosure" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="enclosure" data-origname="add">at all</tei-add>. Art is our spirited<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> protest, our<tei-milestone facs="#f003_z007" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z006" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">gallant </tei-add>attempt to teach Nature<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> her proper place. As for the infinite<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> variety of Nature, that is a <tei-milestone n="Intentions_4" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> pure<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> myth.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">5</tei-note> It is not to be found in<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nature <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" data-origname="add">herself </tei-add><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z009" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">it self</tei-del><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f003_z010" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del"> but,</tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">. It resides</tei-add> in the imagination,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> or fancy, or <tei-milestone facs="#f003_z013" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z012" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">cultivated blindness</tei-add> <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z011" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">whim </tei-del>of the man who<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> looks at her.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f003_z014" hand="#comp" place="above" rend="pencil" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="underline" data-origname="hi">C</tei-hi></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f003_z014" hand="#comp" place="above" rend="pencil" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="underline" data-origname="hi">.</tei-hi></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f003_z014" hand="#comp" rend="pencil" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">Cyril</tei-hi>.</tei-del> Well, you need not look at<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the landscape. You can lie on<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the grass and smoke and talk.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f003_z015" hand="#comp" place="above" rend="pencil" data-origname="add"><tei-hi change="#StC" facs="#f003_z015" hand="#comp" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">V</tei-hi></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">ivian</tei-hi></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f003_z015" hand="#comp" place="above" rend="pencil" data-origname="add"><tei-hi change="#StC" facs="#f003_z015" hand="#comp" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">. </tei-hi></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f003_z015" hand="#comp" rend="pencil" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">Vivian.</tei-hi></tei-del> But <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">N</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">n</tei-del>ature is so uncomfortable.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Grass is hard and lumpy and damp,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and full of dreadful black insects<tei-add change="#StBa" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add">.</tei-add> <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z017" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">that are always stinging poor <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> humanity, </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z016" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z017" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">in order</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z017" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del"> to show their gratitude<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to their Creator. </tei-del>Why<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> even <tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">Maple</tei-del><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">6</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Morris'</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">7</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> poorest workman could </tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">can </tei-del>make you a more comfortable<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> seat than the whole of <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">N</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">n</tei-del>ature can. Nature pales <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>before the <tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">Tottenham Court Road.</tei-del> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">furniture of "the street which from Oxford has borrowed its name,” as the poet you love so much once vilely phrased it.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">8</tei-note> I<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> don't complain. If <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">N</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">n</tei-del>ature had been <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>comfortable<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> mankind would never have<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> invented architecture, and I prefer <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>houses to the open air. In a house<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> we all feel of the proper proportions.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Everything is subordinated to us,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> fashioned for our use and <tei-milestone facs="#f003_z019" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f003_z018" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">our </tei-add>pleasure.</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
			</tei-div>
			<tei-div change="#StB" n="3" type="r" data-origname="div">
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">

<tei-text data-xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="Fluid_Reading_Text" id="Fluid_Reading_Text" data-origname="text"><tei-body data-origname="body"><tei-div change="#StB" n="3" type="r" data-origname="div"><tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp"><tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-pb facs="#f004" data-origname="pb" data-empty=""></tei-pb><tei-milestone facs="#f004_z000" n="3" unit="folio_number" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z002" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">Egoism</tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z003" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">Egotism</tei-add> itself, which is so <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z004" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">essential </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z005" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">necessary</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">the </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z007" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">a proper</tei-add> sense of human dignity, is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">absolutely </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">entirely</tei-add> the result of indoor life.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Out of doors one becomes abstract and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> impersonal.<tei-milestone n="nc_36" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> One's individuality absolutely<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> leaves one. And then <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">N</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">n</tei-del>ature is so<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> indifferent, so unappreciative. Whenever<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am walking in the park<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z009" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">here,</tei-add> I always<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> feel that I am no more to <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">her </tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#StC" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">nature</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del data-origname="del">her </tei-del>than<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the cattle that browse on the slope, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the burdock that blooms in the ditch.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nothing is more evident than that Nature<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> hates <tei-add change="#StC" hand="#StCb" place="nc" data-origname="add">M</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">m</tei-del>ind. Thinking is the most<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> unhealthy thing in the world, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> people die of it just as <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">they die</tei-add> of any<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> other disease. Fortunately, in England at<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">any rate</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z012" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del"> least</tei-del>, <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">thought</tei-add> <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z013" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">it </tei-del>is not catching. Our splendid<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> physique as a <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">nation </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">people </tei-add>is entirely due<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to our national stupidity. I only <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>hope we shall be able to keep this<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> great <tei-milestone facs="#f004_z017" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z016" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">historic </tei-add>bulwark <tei-milestone n="Intentions_5" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> of our happiness<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z019" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z018" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="enclosure" data-origname="add">for many years to come<tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">;</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> but<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am afraid <tei-milestone facs="#f004_z021" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z020" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">that </tei-add>we are <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z023" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">beginning to be</tei-add> <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z022" hand="#Wilde" rend="mulit-stroke" data-origname="del">becoming </tei-del>over-educated;<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">9</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> at least everybody who is incapable<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of learning has taken to teaching<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f004_z025" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">.</tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>that is really what our enthusiasm<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> for education has come to. In the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> mean<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f004_z027" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">time</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f004_z027" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">while</tei-del>, you had better go back to<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> your wearisome uncomfortable Nature,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and leave me to correct my proofs. <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">C</tei-hi><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f004_z001" hand="#comp" rend="pencil" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-add><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">.</tei-hi> Writing an <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z026" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">[illegible]</tei-del> article! That<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> is not very consistent after what<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> you have just said.</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
			</tei-div>
			<tei-div change="#StB" n="4" type="r" data-origname="div">
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p" data-empty=""></tei-p></tei-sp></tei-div></tei-body></tei-text>

Whenever<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am walking in the park<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z009" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">here,</tei-add> I always<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> feel that I am no more to <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">her </tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#StC" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">nature</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del data-origname="del">her </tei-del>than<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the cattle that browse on the slope, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the burdock that blooms in the ditch.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nothing is more evident than that Nature<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> hates <tei-add change="#StC" hand="#StCb" place="nc" data-origname="add">M</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">m</tei-del>ind. Thinking is the most<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> unhealthy thing in the world, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> people die of it just as <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">they die</tei-add> of any<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> other disease. Our splendid<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> physique as a <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">nation </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">people </tei-add>is entirely due<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to our national stupidity. Whenever<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am walking in the park<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z009" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">here,</tei-add> I always<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> feel that I am no more to <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">her </tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#StC" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">nature</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del data-origname="del">her </tei-del>than<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the cattle that browse on the slope, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the burdock that blooms in the ditch.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nothing is more evident than that Nature<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> hates <tei-add change="#StC" hand="#StCb" place="nc" data-origname="add">M</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">m</tei-del>ind. Thinking is the most<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> unhealthy thing in the world, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> people die of it just as <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">they die</tei-add> of any<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> other disease. Our splendid<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> physique as a <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">nation </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">people </tei-add>is entirely due<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to our national stupidity. Whenever<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am walking in the park<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z009" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">here,</tei-add> I always<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> feel that I am no more to <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">her </tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#StC" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">nature</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del data-origname="del">her </tei-del>than<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the cattle that browse on the slope, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the burdock that blooms in the ditch.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nothing is more evident than that Nature<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> hates <tei-add change="#StC" hand="#StCb" place="nc" data-origname="add">M</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">m</tei-del>ind. Thinking is the most<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> unhealthy thing in the world, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> people die of it just as <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">they die</tei-add> of any<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> other disease. Our splendid<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> physique as a <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">nation </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">people </tei-add>is entirely due<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to our national stupidity. Whenever<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am walking in the park<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z009" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">here,</tei-add> I always<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> feel that I am no more to <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">her </tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#StC" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">nature</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del data-origname="del">her </tei-del>than<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the cattle that browse on the slope, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the burdock that blooms in the ditch.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nothing is more evident than that Nature<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> hates <tei-add change="#StC" hand="#StCb" place="nc" data-origname="add">M</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">m</tei-del>ind. Thinking is the most<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> unhealthy thing in the world, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> people die of it just as <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">they die</tei-add> of any<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> other disease. Our splendid<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> physique as a <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">nation </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">people </tei-add>is entirely due<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to our national stupidity. And then <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">N</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">n</tei-del>ature is so<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> indifferent, so unappreciative. Whenever<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am walking in the park<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z009" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">here,</tei-add> I always<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> feel that I am no more to <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">her </tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#StC" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">nature</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del data-origname="del">her </tei-del>than<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the cattle that browse on the slope, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the burdock that blooms in the ditch.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nothing is more evident than that Nature<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> hates <tei-add change="#StC" hand="#StCb" place="nc" data-origname="add">M</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">m</tei-del>ind. Thinking is the most<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> unhealthy thing in the world, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> people die of it just as <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">they die</tei-add> of any<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> other disease. Fortunately, in England at<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">any rate</tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z012" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del"> least</tei-del>, <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">thought</tei-add> <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f004_z013" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">it </tei-del>is not catching. Our splendid<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> physique as a <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">nation </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">people </tei-add>is entirely due<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to our national stupidity. I only <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>hope we shall be able to keep this<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> great <tei-milestone facs="#f004_z017" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z016" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">historic </tei-add>bulwark <tei-milestone n="Intentions_5" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> of our happiness<tei-milestone facs="#f004_z019" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z018" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="enclosure" data-origname="add">for many years to come<tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">;</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> but<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am afraid <tei-milestone facs="#f004_z021" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z020" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">that </tei-add>we are <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z023" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">beginning to be</tei-add> <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f004_z022" hand="#Wilde" rend="mulit-stroke" data-origname="del">becoming </tei-del>over-educated;<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">9</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> at least everybody who is incapable<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of learning has taken to teaching<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f004_z025" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">.</tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>that is really what our enthusiasm<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> for education has come to. In the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> mean<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f004_z027" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">time</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f004_z027" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">while</tei-del>, you had better go back to<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> your wearisome uncomfortable Nature,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and leave me to correct my proofs. <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>

Who wants to be consistent?<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">10</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> The dullard and the doctrinaire<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f005_z007" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f005_z007" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the tedious people who carry out their<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> principles to the bitter end of action, <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f005_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">to </tei-add><tei-milestone facs="#f005_z009" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>the <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-hi change="#StB" facs="#f005_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="italic" data-origname="hi">reductio ad absurdum</tei-hi> of practice. Not<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I. Like Emerson, I write over the door<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of my library the word " "Whim."<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">11</tei-note> Besides<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">,</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> my article is really a most salutary<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and valuable warning. If it is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> attended to, there may be a new<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Renaissance of Art.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">12</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>

					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-hi change="#StB" facs="#f005_z002" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">C</tei-hi><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f005_z002" hand="#comp" rend="pencil" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" facs="#f005_z002" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-add>. What is the subject<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f005_z010" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f005_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">?</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>

I should <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>have thought that our politicians kept<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> up that <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f005_z012" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">art </tei-del>habit.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>

I assure you that they do not. They<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> never rise beyond the level of<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> misrepresentation, and actually condescend<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to prove, to discuss, to argue. How <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>different from the temper of the true<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> liar<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> with his frank<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> fearless statements,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> his superb irresponsibility, his healthy<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> natural disdain of proof of any<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> kind<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f005_z013" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f005_z013" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">!</tei-add> After all, what is a fine<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> lie? Simply that which is its own<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> evidence.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">13</tei-note> If a man is sufficiently<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> unimaginative to produce evidence in<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> support of a lie<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> he might just as</tei-p>

Something may, perhaps, be urged on behalf of the Bar. The mantle of the Sophist has fallen on its members. Their feigned ardours and unreal rhetoric are delightful. They can make the worse appear the better cause, as though they were fresh from Leontine schools,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">14</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> and have been known to wrest from reluctant juries triumphant verdicts of acquittal for their clients, even when those clients, as often happens, were clearly and unmistakeably innocent. But they are briefed by the prosaic, and are not ashamed to appeal to precedent. In spite of their endeavours, the truth will out. Newspapers, even, have degenerated. They may now be absolutely relied upon. One feels it as one wades through their columns. It is always the unreadable that occurs. I am afraid that there is not much to be said in favour of either the lawyer or the journalist.</tei-add> besides, what<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am pleading for is <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f006_z002" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f006_z002" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f006_z002" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ying in<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f006_z003" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f006_z003" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">a</tei-add>rt. Oh, The Tired Hedonists of course.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> It is a club to which I belong. Something may, perhaps, be urged on behalf of the Bar. The mantle of the Sophist has fallen on its members. Their feigned ardours and unreal rhetoric are delightful. They can make the worse appear the better cause, as though they were fresh from Leontine schools,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">14</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> and have been known to wrest from reluctant juries triumphant verdicts of acquittal for their clients, even when those clients, as often happens, were clearly and unmistakeably innocent. I am afraid that there is not much to be said in favour of either the lawyer or the journalist.</tei-add> besides, what<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I am pleading for is <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f006_z002" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f006_z002" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f006_z002" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ying in<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f006_z003" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f006_z003" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">a</tei-add>rt. Lying and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f008_z004" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">p</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f008_z004" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">P</tei-del>oetry are arts<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f008_z005" hand="#StCb" data-origname="del">,</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f008_z005" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>arts, as Plato saw<tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> not unconnected with each other<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f008_z006" hand="#StCb" data-origname="del">,</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f008_z006" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> they require the most careful study,<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">26</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the most disinterested devotion. Indeed,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> they have their technique, just as the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f008_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add">more material arts of</tei-add> painting and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> sculpture have, their subtle secrets of<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> form and colour, their craft-mysteries,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> their deliberate artistic methods. As<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> one knows the poet by his fine music,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> so one can recognise the <tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f008_z007" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f008_z007" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del>iar by his</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
			</tei-div>

<tei-text data-xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="Fluid_Reading_Text" id="Fluid_Reading_Text" data-origname="text"><tei-body data-origname="body"><tei-div change="#StB" n="8" type="r" data-origname="div"><tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp"><tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-pb facs="#f009" data-origname="pb" data-empty=""></tei-pb><tei-milestone facs="#f009_z000" n="8" unit="folio_number" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>rich rhythmic utterances, and in<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> neither case will the casual inspiration<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of the moment suffice. Here, as<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> elsewhere, practice must precede<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> perfection. But in modern days while<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the fashion of <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f009_z001" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">reading </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f009_z002" hand="#Wilde" place="above" data-origname="add">writing </tei-add>poetry has<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> become far too common, and should, if<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> possible<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f009_z003" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f009_z003" data-origname="del">,</tei-del></tei-add> be discouraged, the fashion<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of lying has almost fallen into<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> disrepute. Many a young man<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> starts in life with a natural gift<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-del change="#StAb" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">of </tei-del><tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">for</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of</tei-add> exaggeration which, if nurtured<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> in congenial and sympathetic surroundings<tei-add change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> or by the imitation of the best models,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> might grow into something really<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-milestone n="nc_38" unit="page_number" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>great and wonderful. But, as a<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> rule, he comes to nothing. He either <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>falls into careless habits of accuracy<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f009_z004" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">....</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f009_z004" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">----</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f009_z005" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">"</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f009_z005" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f009_z005" data-origname="del">'</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f009_z005" place="intentions" data-origname="add">"</tei-add> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-hi change="#StB" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">C</tei-hi><tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-add>. My dear <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f009_z006" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">fellow </tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f009_z006" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">Vivian</tei-del>!</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-hi change="#StB" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">V</tei-hi><tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" rend="pencil" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">ivian</tei-hi></tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">ivian</tei-hi></tei-add>. Please don<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f009_z013" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">'</tei-add>t interrupt in the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> middle of a sentence. <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f009_z007" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">"</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f009_z007" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f009_z007" data-origname="del">'</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f009_z007" place="intentions" data-origname="add">"</tei-add>He either<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> falls into careless habits of accuracy,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> or takes to frequenting the society of<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the aged and the well-informed. Both<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> things are equally fatal to his<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> imagination, as indeed they would be<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-milestone facs="#f009_z009" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f009_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="margin above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">fatal </tei-add>to the imagination of anybody, and in <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>a short time he develops a<tei-milestone n="intentions_9" unit="page_number" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>morbid<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and unhealthy faculty of truth-telling,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> begins to verify all statements made<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> in his presence, has no hesitation in</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
			</tei-div>
			<tei-div change="#StB" n="9" type="r" data-origname="div">
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p" data-empty=""></tei-p></tei-sp></tei-div></tei-body></tei-text>

Here, as<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> elsewhere, practice must precede<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> perfection. Many a young man<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> starts in life with a natural gift<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-del change="#StAb" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">of </tei-del><tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">for</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f009_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of</tei-add> exaggeration which, if nurtured<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> in congenial and sympathetic surroundings<tei-add change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> or by the imitation of the best models,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> might grow into something really<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-milestone n="nc_38" unit="page_number" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>great and wonderful. It is simply one example out<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of many<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f010_z006" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">;</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f010_z006" hand="#comp" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> and if something cannot be<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> done to check, or at least to modify,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> our monstrous worship of facts<tei-add change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" place="inspace" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f010_z007" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f010_z007" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f010_z007" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f010_z007" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del>rt<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> will become sterile, and <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f010_z008" place="intentions" data-origname="add">B</tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f010_z008" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f010_z008" data-origname="del">b</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f010_z008" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">B</tei-del>eauty will<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> pass away from the land.<tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">"</tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>

As for Mr Rider Haggard<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f010_z019" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> who really has, or had once, the makings<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of a perfectly magnificent liar, he<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> is now so afraid of being suspected of<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> genius that when he does tell us<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> anything marvellous<tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f010_z020" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> he feels bound<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to invent a personal reminiscence, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to put it into a footnote as a kind<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of cowardly corroboration.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">28</tei-note> Nor are our<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> other novelists much better. <tei-text data-xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="Fluid_Reading_Text" id="Fluid_Reading_Text" data-origname="text"><tei-body data-origname="body"><tei-div change="#StB" n="14" type="r" data-origname="div"><tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp"><tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-pb facs="#f015" data-origname="pb" data-empty=""></tei-pb><tei-milestone facs="#f015_z000" n="14" unit="folio_number" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>However, my dear Cyril, I will not detain<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> you any further <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f015_z004" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">on this point </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f015_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">just here</tei-add>. <tei-del change="#StAb" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">so I will conent myself with saying that they have many good qualities, but that, as a class, they are </tei-del><tei-del change="#StA" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">quite </tei-del><tei-add change="#StAb" hand="#Wilde" place="berg" data-origname="add"><tei-del data-origname="del">absolutely </tei-del></tei-add><tei-del data-origname="del">unreadable.</tei-del> <tei-add change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add">I quite admit<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> that modern novels have many good points. 				</tei-sp>

Even in Shakespeare we can <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>see the beginning of the end.<tei-note facs="#f024_z004" rend="small" data-origname="note">An exclamation mark or full stop rendered as flourish connected to "end" is printed as full stop in NC (Bristow and Mitchell 136).</tei-note> It shows <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>itself <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f024_z005" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">it </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f024_z006" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">by </tei-add>the gradual breaking up <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>of the blank-verse <tei-milestone facs="#f024_z007" unit="enclosure" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f024_z007" hand="#Wilde" place="above inline" rend="enclosure" data-origname="add">in the later plays,</tei-add> by the predominance<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> given to prose, and by the over-importance <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f024_z009" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">given </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f024_z010" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">assigned </tei-add>to characterisation. The passages<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> in Shakespeare--and they are many--<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>where the language is uncouth, vulgar, <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>exaggerated, fantastic, obscene even, <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>are entirely due to <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f024_z011" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f024_z011" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f024_z011" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f024_z011" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del>ife calling for <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>an echo of her own voice, and rejecting<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-milestone n="intentions_20" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>the intervention of beautiful style, through <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>which alone <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f024_z012" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">it </tei-del>should <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f024_z012" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Life </tei-add>be <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f024_z013" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">allowed </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f024_z013" hand="#Wilde" place="inspace" data-origname="add">suffered </tei-add>to<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> find expression. Shakespeare is not by <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>any means a flawless artist. He<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> is too fond of going directly to <tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f024_z014" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f024_z014" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del>ife,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and borrowing <tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f024_z015" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f024_z015" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del>ife's natural utterance<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> He forgets that when <tei-add change="#StD" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi change="#StC" rend="italic" data-origname="hi">A</tei-hi></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f023_z022" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StC" rend="italic" data-origname="hi">a</tei-hi></tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StC" rend="italic" data-origname="hi">A</tei-hi></tei-del><tei-hi change="#StC" rend="italic" data-origname="hi">rt surrenders </tei-hi><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-hi change="#StC" rend="italic" data-origname="hi">her imaginative medium she surrenders <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>everything</tei-hi>. Goethe says somewhere--<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-note facs="#f024_z017" rend="small" data-origname="note">"Printer's pencil mark with illegible word at start of line" (Bristow and Mitchell 136). result <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>of this substitution of an imitative for <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>a creative medium, this surrender of an <tei-lb Sims. These </tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">gentleman are, </tei-del><tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f025_z007" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">we </tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">are told, admirable</tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del"> dramatists, almost as admirable as they </tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">are popular</tei-del>.<tei-note data-origname="note" data-empty=""></tei-note> The<tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z005" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">ir</tei-del> characters<tei-milestone facs="#f025_z004" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add facs="#f025_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">in these plays</tei-add> talk <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>on the stage exactly as they would talk <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>off it; They do not <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>succeed in producing even that impression<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> of reality at which they aim, and<tei-milestone n="intentions_21" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> which<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> is <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f025_z015" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">there </tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f025_z015" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">their </tei-add>only reason for existing. As a <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>method, realism is a complete failure. <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" data-origname="del">'</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" place="intentions" data-origname="add">"</tei-add>What is true about the <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z018" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">drama and</tei-add><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z016" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">imitative</tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z017" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del"> form of literature </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f025_z019" hand="#Wilde" place="above left" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">the novel</tei-add> is no less true<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">70</tei-note> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>about those arts that we call the <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>decorative arts. The whole history of <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f025_z020" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">decorative art </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f025_z020" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">these arts </tei-add>in Europe is the <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>record of the struggle between Orientalism<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f025_z021" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>with its frank rejection of imitation,</tei-p>

My dear fellow, whatever you<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> may say, it is merely a dramatic<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> utterance, and no more represents<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Shakespeare's real views upon <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f032_z004" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z004" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f032_z004" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del>rt<tei-del change="#StAb" facs="#f032_z004" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">,</tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> th<tei-del change="#StAb" facs="#f032_z005" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">e</tei-del>an the speeches of Iago represent<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> his real views upon morals. But<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> let me get to the end of the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> passage<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f032_z006" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f032_z006" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">:<tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z006" data-origname="del">--</tei-del></tei-add> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z007" place="intentions" data-origname="add">"</tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f032_z007" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z007" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">'</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f032_z007" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">"</tei-del>Art finds her own perfection within,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f032_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="caret" data-origname="add">not </tei-add><tei-milestone facs="#f032_z008" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>outside<tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z009" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of</tei-add>, herself. She is not to<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> be judged by any external standard <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>of <tei-del change="#StB" facs="#f032_z010" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">perfection </tei-del><tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f032_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">resemblance</tei-add>. She is a <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>veil, rather than a mirror. She has <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>flowers that no <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f032_z012" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">B</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f032_z012" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z012" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">b</tei-del></tei-add><tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z012" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">otanist </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z012" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">forests </tei-add>know of,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> birds that no <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z013" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">museum </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z013" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">woodland </tei-add>possesses. She<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> makes and unmakes<tei-milestone n="nc_47" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> many worlds, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> can draw the moon from <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z014" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StE" facs="#f032_z014" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">the </tei-del></tei-add>heaven with<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> a scarlet thread. Hers are the <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z015" data-origname="del">"</tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z015" place="intentions" data-origname="add">'</tei-add>forms<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> more real than living man,<tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f032_z016" data-origname="del">"</tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f032_z016" place="intentions" data-origname="add">'</tei-add> <tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">88</tei-note>and hers<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the great archetypes of which things<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> that<tei-milestone facs="#f032_z017" unit="x" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f032_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="x" data-origname="add">have </tei-add>exist<tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f032_z018" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">ence</tei-add> are but unfinished copies.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Nature has<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f032_z019" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> in her eyes, no laws, no<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> uniformity. She can work miracles at<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> her will, and when she calls monsters<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-milestone n="intentions_26" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> from the deep<tei-del change="#StAb" facs="#f032_z020" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">,</tei-del> they come. She can bid <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>the almond<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f032_z021" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">-</tei-del>tree blossom in winter, and <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>send the snow upon the ripe cornfield.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">89</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> At her <tei-del change="#StAb" facs="#f032_z022" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">bidding </tei-del><tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f032_z022" hand="#Wilde" place="inline" data-origname="add">word </tei-add>the frost lays its silver<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> finger on the burning mouth of June,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and the winged lions creep out from<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the hollows of the Lydian hills. hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del"> in hand</tei-del>. This <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z009" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">curious and </tei-del>interesting<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> phenomenon<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> which always occurs after<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the appearance of a new edition of <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>either of the books I have <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f036_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">named </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f036_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">alluded to</tei-add>, is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> usually attributed to the influence of<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> literature on the imagination. The imagination is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> essentially creative, and always seeks for<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> a new form. S<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z015" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">c</tei-add><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z015" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">c</tei-del>hopenhauer<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> has analy<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z016" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">s</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f036_z016" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">z</tei-del>ed the pessimism that <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>characterises modern thought, but Hamlet<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> invented it. The world has become sad <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>because a puppet was once melancholy.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> The Nihilist, that strange martyr <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z017" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">without </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z018" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">who has</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z019" hand="#Wilde" place="above left margin" rend="caret" data-origname="add"> no</tei-add> <tei-milestone facs="#f036_z019" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>faith, who goes to the stake <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z020" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">because he </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z022" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">without </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z021" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">has no </tei-del>enthusiasm<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z023" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> and dies for what he<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> does not believe in, is a purely literary <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>product. hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del"> in hand</tei-del>. This <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z009" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">curious and </tei-del>interesting<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> phenomenon<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> which always occurs after<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the appearance of a new edition of <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>either of the books I have <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f036_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">named </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f036_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">alluded to</tei-add>, is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> usually attributed to the influence of<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> literature on the imagination. But this<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> is a mistake. The imagination is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> essentially creative, and always seeks for<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> a new form. The boy-burglar is <tei-milestone facs="#f036_z012" unit="enclosure" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z012" hand="#Wilde" place="above left" rend="enclosure" data-origname="add">simply </tei-add>the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> inevitable result of <tei-add change="#StB" facs="#f036_z013" hand="#Wilde" place="overwritten" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f036_z013" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z013" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add>ife's imitative<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> instinct. S<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z015" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">c</tei-add><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z015" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">c</tei-del>hopenhauer<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> has analy<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z016" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">s</tei-add><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f036_z016" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">z</tei-del>ed the pessimism that <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>characterises modern thought, but Hamlet<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> invented it. The world has become sad <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>because a puppet was once melancholy.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> The Nihilist, that strange martyr <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z017" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">without </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z018" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">who has</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z019" hand="#Wilde" place="above left margin" rend="caret" data-origname="add"> no</tei-add> <tei-milestone facs="#f036_z019" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>faith, who goes to the stake <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z020" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">because he </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z022" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">without </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f036_z021" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">has no </tei-del>enthusiasm<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f036_z023" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> and dies for what he<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> does not believe in, is a purely literary <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>product. data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>wear the most horsey clothes, and<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> talk about nothing but betting. <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z001" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">She abandoned religion for mesmerism, mesmerism for politics, and politics for the melodramatic excitements of philanthropy.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">105</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z001" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> In fact, </tei-add>she was<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> a kind of Proteus, and <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f040_z002" hand="#Wilde" place="above inline" rend="caret" data-origname="add">as much</tei-add><tei-milestone facs="#f040_z002" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> a failure in all<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> her transformations as <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z003" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">the </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z003" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">was that wondrous </tei-add>sea-god <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z004" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">was </tei-del><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>when Odysseus <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z005" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">got </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z005" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">laid </tei-add>hold of <tei-milestone n="nc_50" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>him. One<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> day a serial began in one of the <tei-note facs="#f040_z006" data-origname="note">The seemingly lighter ink suggests that "French" was inserted later.</tei-note><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f040_z006" hand="#Wilde" place="inline margin" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">French</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> magazines. At that time I used to<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> read serial stories, and I well remember<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the shock of surprise I felt when I<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> came to the description of the heroine.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> She was so like my friend that I <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>brought her the magazine, and she<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> recognised herself in it immediately<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f040_z007" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and seemed fascinated by the resemblance.<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I should tell you, by the way, that the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> story was translated from <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z008" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">the Russian </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z008" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">some dead Russian writer</tei-add>, <tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">106</tei-note>so<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> that the author had not taken his type<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> from my friend. Well, to <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z009" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">cut </tei-del>put the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> matter briefly, some months afterwards<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> I was in Venice, and finding the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> magazine in the reading-room of the <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f040_z010" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">H</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f040_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">h</tei-add>otel<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f040_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> I took it up casually to see what had<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> become of the heroine. It was a most <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>piteous tale, as the <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z011" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">heroine </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">girl </tei-add>had ended<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> by running away with a man <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z012" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">absolutely </tei-add>inferior<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to her<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f040_z013" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> not merely in social station<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>, but in character and intellect also. I wrote<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to my friend that evening <tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z014" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">about my views on John Bellini,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">107</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z014" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> and the admirable ices at Florio's, and the artistic value of gondolas, but</tei-add> <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z014" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">and </tei-del>added<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> a postscript to the effect that her<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> double<tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> in the story </tei-add><tei-milestone n="intentions_32" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>had behaved in a very silly<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> manner. I don't know why I <tei-del change="#StD" facs="#f040_z016" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">wrote </tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f040_z016" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">added that, </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>but I remember I had a sort of <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>dread over me that she might do the</tei-p>
