hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt far more than <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt imitates <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and I feel sure that if you think<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> seriously about it you will find<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> that it is true. <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z003" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">Art </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">ife</tei-add> holds the mirror<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> up to <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt, and either reproduces <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z005" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">the </tei-del>some<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> strange type <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z007" hand="#Wilde" place="above inline" rend="guiding_line" data-origname="add">imagined by</tei-add> <tei-milestone facs="#f042_z007" unit="guiding_line" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">of </tei-del>painter or sculptor, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> realises in fact what has been<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> dreamed in fiction. Scientifically speaking,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the basis of <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add>ife<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z008" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z009" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>the energy of <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z010" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add>ife<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> as Aristotle would call it<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z009" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z009" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>is simply<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the desire for expression, and <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> always presenting various forms through<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> which <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="above inline" rend="caret" data-origname="add">this </tei-add><tei-milestone facs="#f042_z011" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>expression can be attained. <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>seizes on them and uses them<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z012" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> even if <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>they be to her own hurt. Young men<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> have committed suicide because Rolla<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">108</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> did so, have<tei-milestone n="intentions 32" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> died by their own hand<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> because by his own hand <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" data-origname="del">Rene </tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" place="nc" data-origname="add">Werther </tei-add>died.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">109</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Think of what we owe to the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> imitation of Christ, of what we owe<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to the imitation of Cæsar. <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">C</tei-hi><tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" rend="pencil" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-add>. The <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">point </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">theory </tei-add>is certainly a very <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>curious one<tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z016" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del"> and entirely new.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">, </tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">110</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">but to make it complete you must show that Nature, no less</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> than Life, is an imitation of Art. Are you prepared</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> to prove that?</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Vivian</tei-hi>. My dear fellow, I am prepared to prove </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">anything.</tei-add> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Cyril.</tei-hi> Nature follows the landscape painter then, and </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">takes her effects from him? </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Vivian</tei-hi></tei-add>. <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Certainly. Where, if not from the Impressionists,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note" data-empty=""></tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> do we get those wonderful brown fogs that come creeping</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> down our streets, blurring the gas-lamps and changing</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the houses into monstrous shadows? To whom, if not to </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">them and their master, do we owe the lovely silver mists</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> that brood over our river, and turn to faint forms of</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> fading grace curved bridge and swaying barge? The </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">extraordinary change that has taken place in the climate</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of London during the last ten years is entirely due to</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> this particular school of Art. You smile. Consider the </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">matter from a scientific or a metaphysical point of view,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> and you will find that I am right. For what is Nature?</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Nature is no great mother who has borne us. She is our </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">creation. It is in our brain that she quickens to life.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Things are because we see them, and what we see, and</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> how we see it, depends on the Arts that have influenced</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> us. To look at a thing is very different from seeing a</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> thing. One does not see anything until one sees its</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> beauty. Then, and then only, does it come into existence.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> At present, people see fogs, not because there</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-milestone n="intentions_35" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are fogs, but because poets and painters have taught </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">them the mysterious loveliness of such effects. There</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> may have been fogs for centuries in London. I dare say </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">there were. But no one saw them, and so we do not</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> know anything about them. They did not exist until</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Art had invented them. Now, it must be admitted, fogs</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are carried to excess. They have become the mere</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> mannerism of a clique, and the exaggerated realism of</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> their method gives dull people bronchitis. Where the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> cultured catch an effect, the uncultured catch cold.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> And so, let us be humane, and invite Art to turn her</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> wonderful eyes elsewhere. She has done so already,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> indeed. That white quivering sunlight that one sees</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> now in France, with its strange blotches of mauve, and </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">its restless violet shadows, is her latest fancy, and, on the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> whole, Nature produces it quite admirably. Where she</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> used to give us Corots and Daubignys,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">112</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> she gives us now </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">exquisite Monets and entrancing Pisaros.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">113</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Indeed there</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are moments, rare, it is true, but still to be observed from</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> time to time, when Nature becomes absolutely modern. </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Of course she is not always to be relied upon. The fact </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">is that she is in this unfortunate position. Art creates</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> an incomparable and unique effect, and, having done so,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> passes on to other things. Nature, upon the other hand, </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">forgetting that imitation can be made the sincerest form</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of insult, keeps on repeating this effect until we all </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">become absolutely wearied of it. Nobody of any real </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">culture, for instance, ever talks now</tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#comp" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">-</tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">a</tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#comp" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">-</tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">days about the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> beauty of the sunset. Sunsets are quite old-fashioned.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">114</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> They belong to the time when Turner was the last note</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> in Art.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">115</tei-note> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">To admire them is a distinct sign of provincialism</tei-add><tei-milestone n="intentions_51" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>of temperament. Upon the other hand<tei-del change="#StE" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del> they go on.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Yesterday evening Mrs. Arundel insisted on my </tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">coming </tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StE" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">going </tei-del>to</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the window, and looking at the glorious sky, as she called</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> it. Of course<tei-del change="#StE" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del> I had to look at it. She is one of those</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> absurdly pretty Philistines, to whom one can deny</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> nothing. And what was it? It was simply a very</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> second-rate Turner, a Turner of a bad period, with all</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the painter's worst faults exaggerated and over-emphasized.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Of course, I am quite ready to admit that Life</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> very often commits the same error. She produces her</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> false Renés and her sham Vautrins, just as Nature gives</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> us, on one day a doubtful Cuyp, and on another a more</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> than questionable Rousseau.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">116</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Still, Nature irritates one</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> more when she does things of that kind. It seems so</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> stupid, so obvious, so unnecessary. A false Vautrin</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> might be delightful. A doubtful Cuyp is unbearable.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">117</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> However, I don't want to be too hard on Nature. I wish</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the Channel, especially at Hastings, did not look quite</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> so often like a Henry Moore, grey pearl with yellow</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> lights, but then, when Art is more varied, Nature will,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> no doubt, be more varied also. That she imitates Art,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> I don't think even her worst enemy would deny now.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> It is the one thing that keeps her in touch with civilized</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> man. But have I proved my theory to your satisfaction. </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Cyril</tei-hi>. You have proved it to my dissatisfaction, which</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> is better.</tei-add> But even<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> admitting this strange imitative<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> instinct in <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife, surely you would <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>acknowledge that <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">a</tei-add>rt expresses the</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>

				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">

Young men<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> have committed suicide because Rolla<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">108</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> did so, have<tei-milestone n="intentions 32" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> died by their own hand<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> because by his own hand <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" data-origname="del">Rene </tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" place="nc" data-origname="add">Werther </tei-add>died.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">109</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Think of what we owe to the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> imitation of Christ, of what we owe<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to the imitation of Cæsar. <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>

The <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">point </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">theory </tei-add>is certainly a very <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>curious one<tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z016" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del"> and entirely new.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">, </tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">110</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">but to make it complete you must show that Nature, no less</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> than Life, is an imitation of Art. My dear fellow, I am prepared to prove </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">anything.</tei-add> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Cyril.</tei-hi> Nature follows the landscape painter then, and </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">takes her effects from him? </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Vivian</tei-hi></tei-add>. <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Certainly. Where, if not from the Impressionists,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note" data-empty=""></tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> do we get those wonderful brown fogs that come creeping</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> down our streets, blurring the gas-lamps and changing</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the houses into monstrous shadows? To whom, if not to </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">them and their master, do we owe the lovely silver mists</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> that brood over our river, and turn to faint forms of</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> fading grace curved bridge and swaying barge? The </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">extraordinary change that has taken place in the climate</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of London during the last ten years is entirely due to</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> this particular school of Art. You smile. Consider the </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">matter from a scientific or a metaphysical point of view,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> and you will find that I am right. For what is Nature?</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Nature is no great mother who has borne us. She is our </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">creation. It is in our brain that she quickens to life.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Things are because we see them, and what we see, and</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> how we see it, depends on the Arts that have influenced</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> us. To look at a thing is very different from seeing a</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> thing. One does not see anything until one sees its</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> beauty. Then, and then only, does it come into existence.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> At present, people see fogs, not because there</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-milestone n="intentions_35" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are fogs, but because poets and painters have taught </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">them the mysterious loveliness of such effects. There</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> may have been fogs for centuries in London. I dare say </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">there were. But no one saw them, and so we do not</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> know anything about them. They did not exist until</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Art had invented them. Now, it must be admitted, fogs</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are carried to excess. They have become the mere</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> mannerism of a clique, and the exaggerated realism of</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> their method gives dull people bronchitis. Where the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> cultured catch an effect, the uncultured catch cold.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> And so, let us be humane, and invite Art to turn her</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> wonderful eyes elsewhere. She has done so already,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> indeed. That white quivering sunlight that one sees</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> now in France, with its strange blotches of mauve, and </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">its restless violet shadows, is her latest fancy, and, on the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> whole, Nature produces it quite admirably. Where she</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> used to give us Corots and Daubignys,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">112</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> she gives us now </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">exquisite Monets and entrancing Pisaros.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">113</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Indeed there</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are moments, rare, it is true, but still to be observed from</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> time to time, when Nature becomes absolutely modern. </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Of course she is not always to be relied upon. The fact </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">is that she is in this unfortunate position. Art creates</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> an incomparable and unique effect, and, having done so,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> passes on to other things. Nature, upon the other hand, </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">forgetting that imitation can be made the sincerest form</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of insult, keeps on repeating this effect until we all </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">become absolutely wearied of it. Nobody of any real </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">culture, for instance, ever talks now</tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#comp" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">-</tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">a</tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#comp" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">-</tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">days about the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> beauty of the sunset. Sunsets are quite old-fashioned.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">114</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> They belong to the time when Turner was the last note</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> in Art.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">115</tei-note> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">To admire them is a distinct sign of provincialism</tei-add><tei-milestone n="intentions_51" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>of temperament. Upon the other hand<tei-del change="#StE" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del> they go on.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Yesterday evening Mrs. Arundel insisted on my </tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">coming </tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StE" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">going </tei-del>to</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the window, and looking at the glorious sky, as she called</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> it. Of course<tei-del change="#StE" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del> I had to look at it. She is one of those</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> absurdly pretty Philistines, to whom one can deny</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> nothing. And what was it? It was simply a very</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> second-rate Turner, a Turner of a bad period, with all</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the painter's worst faults exaggerated and over-emphasized.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Of course, I am quite ready to admit that Life</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> very often commits the same error. She produces her</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> false Renés and her sham Vautrins, just as Nature gives</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> us, on one day a doubtful Cuyp, and on another a more</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> than questionable Rousseau.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">116</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Still, Nature irritates one</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> more when she does things of that kind. It seems so</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> stupid, so obvious, so unnecessary. A false Vautrin</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> might be delightful. A doubtful Cuyp is unbearable.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">117</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> However, I don't want to be too hard on Nature. I wish</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the Channel, especially at Hastings, did not look quite</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> so often like a Henry Moore, grey pearl with yellow</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> lights, but then, when Art is more varied, Nature will,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> no doubt, be more varied also. That she imitates Art,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> I don't think even her worst enemy would deny now.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> It is the one thing that keeps her in touch with civilized</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> man. But have I proved my theory to your satisfaction. </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Cyril</tei-hi>. You have proved it to my dissatisfaction, which</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> is better.</tei-add> But even<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> admitting this strange imitative<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> instinct in <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife, surely you would <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>acknowledge that <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">a</tei-add>rt expresses the</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
			</tei-div>
			<tei-div change="#StB" n="42" type="r" data-origname="div">
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p" data-empty=""></tei-p></tei-sp></tei-div></tei-body></tei-text>

<tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" that if you think<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> seriously about it you will find<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> that it is true. <tei-del change="#StBa" A doubtful Cuyp is unbearable.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">117</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> However, I don't want to be too hard on Nature. I wish</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the Channel, especially at Hastings, did not look quite</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> so often like a Henry Moore, grey pearl with yellow</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> lights, but then, when Art is more varied, Nature will,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> no doubt, be more varied also. That she imitates Art,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> I don't think even her worst enemy would deny now.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> It is the one thing that keeps her in touch with civilized</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> man. But have I proved my theory to your satisfaction. </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Cyril</tei-hi>. You have proved it to my dissatisfaction, which</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> is better.</tei-add> But even<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> admitting this strange imitative<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> instinct in <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife, surely you would <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>acknowledge that <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">a</tei-add>rt expresses the</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>

				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">

Personal<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-milestone facs="#f042_z002" unit="guiding_line" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> <tei-add change="#StBa" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt far more than <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt imitates <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> and I feel sure that if you think<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> seriously about it you will find<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> that it is true. <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z003" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">Art </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z004" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">ife</tei-add> holds the mirror<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> up to <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt, and either reproduces <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z005" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">the </tei-del>some<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> strange type <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z007" hand="#Wilde" place="above inline" rend="guiding_line" data-origname="add">imagined by</tei-add> <tei-milestone facs="#f042_z007" unit="guiding_line" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z006" hand="#Wilde" rend="multi-stroke" data-origname="del">of </tei-del>painter or sculptor, or<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> realises in fact what has been<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> dreamed in fiction. Scientifically speaking,<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the basis of <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add>ife<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z008" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z009" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>the energy of <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z010" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">l</tei-add>ife<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z010" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> as Aristotle would call it<tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z009" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z009" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">--</tei-add>is simply<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> the desire for expression, and <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">a</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">A</tei-add>rt is<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> always presenting various forms through<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> which <tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z011" hand="#Wilde" place="above inline" rend="caret" data-origname="add">this </tei-add><tei-milestone facs="#f042_z011" unit="caret" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone>expression can be attained. <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>seizes on them and uses them<tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z012" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">,</tei-add> even if <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>they be to her own hurt. Young men<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> have committed suicide because Rolla<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">108</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> did so, have<tei-milestone n="intentions 32" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> died by their own hand<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> because by his own hand <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" data-origname="del">Rene </tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" place="nc" data-origname="add">Werther </tei-add>died.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">109</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Think of what we owe to the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> imitation of Christ, of what we owe<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to the imitation of Cæsar. <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">C</tei-hi><tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" rend="pencil" data-origname="del"><tei-hi change="#StB" hand="#Wilde" rend="underline" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">yril</tei-hi></tei-add>. The <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">point </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">theory </tei-add>is certainly a very <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>curious one<tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z016" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del"> and entirely new.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">, </tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">110</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">but to make it complete you must show that Nature, no less</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> than Life, is an imitation of Art. Are you prepared</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> to prove that?</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Vivian</tei-hi>. My dear fellow, I am prepared to prove </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">anything.</tei-add> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Cyril.</tei-hi> Nature follows the landscape painter then, and </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">takes her effects from him? </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#V." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Vivian</tei-hi></tei-add>. <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Certainly. Where, if not from the Impressionists,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note" data-empty=""></tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> do we get those wonderful brown fogs that come creeping</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> down our streets, blurring the gas-lamps and changing</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the houses into monstrous shadows? To whom, if not to </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">them and their master, do we owe the lovely silver mists</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> that brood over our river, and turn to faint forms of</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> fading grace curved bridge and swaying barge? The </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">extraordinary change that has taken place in the climate</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of London during the last ten years is entirely due to</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> this particular school of Art. You smile. Consider the </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">matter from a scientific or a metaphysical point of view,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> and you will find that I am right. For what is Nature?</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Nature is no great mother who has borne us. She is our </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">creation. It is in our brain that she quickens to life.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Things are because we see them, and what we see, and</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> how we see it, depends on the Arts that have influenced</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> us. To look at a thing is very different from seeing a</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> thing. One does not see anything until one sees its</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> beauty. Then, and then only, does it come into existence.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> At present, people see fogs, not because there</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-milestone n="intentions_35" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are fogs, but because poets and painters have taught </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">them the mysterious loveliness of such effects. There</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> may have been fogs for centuries in London. I dare say </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">there were. But no one saw them, and so we do not</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> know anything about them. They did not exist until</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Art had invented them. Now, it must be admitted, fogs</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are carried to excess. They have become the mere</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> mannerism of a clique, and the exaggerated realism of</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> their method gives dull people bronchitis. Where the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> cultured catch an effect, the uncultured catch cold.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> And so, let us be humane, and invite Art to turn her</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> wonderful eyes elsewhere. She has done so already,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> indeed. That white quivering sunlight that one sees</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> now in France, with its strange blotches of mauve, and </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">its restless violet shadows, is her latest fancy, and, on the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> whole, Nature produces it quite admirably. Where she</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> used to give us Corots and Daubignys,</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">112</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> she gives us now </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">exquisite Monets and entrancing Pisaros.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">113</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Indeed there</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> are moments, rare, it is true, but still to be observed from</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> time to time, when Nature becomes absolutely modern. </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">Of course she is not always to be relied upon. The fact </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">is that she is in this unfortunate position. Art creates</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> an incomparable and unique effect, and, having done so,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> passes on to other things. Nature, upon the other hand, </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">forgetting that imitation can be made the sincerest form</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> of insult, keeps on repeating this effect until we all </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">become absolutely wearied of it. Nobody of any real </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">culture, for instance, ever talks now</tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#comp" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">-</tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">a</tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#comp" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">-</tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">days about the</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> beauty of the sunset. Sunsets are quite old-fashioned.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">114</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> They belong to the time when Turner was the last note</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> in Art.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">115</tei-note> <tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">To admire them is a distinct sign of provincialism</tei-add><tei-milestone n="intentions_51" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>of temperament. Upon the other hand<tei-del change="#StE" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del> they go on.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Yesterday evening Mrs. Arundel insisted on my </tei-add><tei-add change="#StE" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions_1894" data-origname="add">coming </tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StE" hand="#Wilde" data-origname="del">going </tei-del>to</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the window, and looking at the glorious sky, as she called</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> it. Of course<tei-del change="#StE" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">,</tei-del> I had to look at it. She is one of those</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> absurdly pretty Philistines, to whom one can deny</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> nothing. And what was it? It was simply a very</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> second-rate Turner, a Turner of a bad period, with all</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the painter's worst faults exaggerated and over-emphasized.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Of course, I am quite ready to admit that Life</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> very often commits the same error. She produces her</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> false Renés and her sham Vautrins, just as Nature gives</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> us, on one day a doubtful Cuyp, and on another a more</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> than questionable Rousseau.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">116</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> Still, Nature irritates one</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> more when she does things of that kind. It seems so</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> stupid, so obvious, so unnecessary. A false Vautrin</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> might be delightful. A doubtful Cuyp is unbearable.</tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">117</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> However, I don't want to be too hard on Nature. I wish</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> the Channel, especially at Hastings, did not look quite</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> so often like a Henry Moore, grey pearl with yellow</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> lights, but then, when Art is more varied, Nature will,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> no doubt, be more varied also. That she imitates Art,</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> I don't think even her worst enemy would deny now.</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> It is the one thing that keeps her in touch with civilized</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> man. But have I proved my theory to your satisfaction. </tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>
				</tei-sp>
				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">
					<tei-p data-origname="p"><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"><tei-hi rend="italic" data-origname="hi">Cyril</tei-hi>. You have proved it to my dissatisfaction, which</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> is better.</tei-add> But even<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> admitting this strange imitative<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> instinct in <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">L</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add"><tei-del change="#StD" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">l</tei-del></tei-add><tei-add change="#StD" hand="#comp" place="intentions" data-origname="add">L</tei-add>ife, surely you would <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>acknowledge that <tei-del change="#StC" hand="#comp" data-origname="del">A</tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" hand="#comp" place="nc" data-origname="add">a</tei-add>rt expresses the</tei-p>
				</tei-sp>

				<tei-sp who="#C." data-origname="sp">

Young men<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> have committed suicide because Rolla<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">108</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> did so, have<tei-milestone n="intentions 32" data-origname="milestone" data-empty=""></tei-milestone> died by their own hand<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> because by his own hand <tei-del change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" data-origname="del">Rene </tei-del><tei-add change="#StC" facs="#f042_z013" place="nc" data-origname="add">Werther </tei-add>died.<tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">109</tei-note><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> Think of what we owe to the<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> imitation of Christ, of what we owe<tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb> to the imitation of Cæsar. <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb></tei-p>

The <tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z014" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del">point </tei-del><tei-add change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z015" hand="#Wilde" place="above" rend="no_caret" data-origname="add">theory </tei-add>is certainly a very <tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb>curious one<tei-del change="#StBa" facs="#f042_z016" hand="#Wilde" rend="single-stroke" data-origname="del"> and entirely new.</tei-del><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">, </tei-add><tei-note rend="small" data-origname="note">110</tei-note><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add">but to make it complete you must show that Nature, no less</tei-add><tei-lb data-origname="lb" data-empty=""></tei-lb><tei-add change="#StD" facs="#f042_z017" hand="#Wilde" place="intentions" data-origname="add"> than Life, is an imitation of Art.
